scripts.verify:rust:quality: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
scripts.verify:fast: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "pnpm typecheck" "pnpm test:worker" "cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features --quiet"
scripts.verify:full: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "pnpm typecheck" "pnpm build:app" "pnpm verify:rust" "pnpm verify:rust:quality"
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify:full && pnpm tauri build --debug --bundles app --config '{"build":{"beforeBuildCommand":""}}'
